text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Be magnificent. Be supreme. Always shine 
with the greatest brilliance—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
In other words, upon this supreme stage—in 
this race, I shall deliver a magnificent 
run—one forged alongside everyone.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
And toward the ultimate brilliance—the 
fastest light.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —Victory for my clan...!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: ...! So fast—

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Mother
text_block_list.text: It has come to pass.

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Mother
text_block_list.text: The new symbol... of the "Splendid Clan."

text_block_list.name: Young Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Mother, what must I do to be able to 
run...!

text_block_list.name: Young Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"No matter what, I want to become the true 
pride of the 'Illustrious Lineage'...!"

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Mother
text_block_list.text:
...Congratulations, Ruby. You are, and 
always will be... my pride.

A racetrack swirling with fervor... Yet 
the usual rowdy clamor was absent; 
everyone welcomed today's victor with 
profound reverence.
(Clap, clap, clap...!!)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Everyone...
(Clap, clap, clap...!!)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Congrats, Ruby. Total defeat for me this 
time!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...So dazzling.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Alright, back to practice! Next up is my 
turn—Ruby.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Milady...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
—She's just waaaay too cool!! My heart is 
pounding so haaaard!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"I knew it... I really do luuuv the young 
lady♪"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"I'm de-finitely! gonna make you fall for 
me☆"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: (...! Mother...)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(Mother is applauding too... She's 
acknowledged me.)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: (And—)

For a brief moment, my eyes met Daiichi 
Ruby's. She quickly turned back to face 
the packed crowd—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Everyone, thank you so much.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
With the radiance I showed you earlier... 
I shall make my declaration.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
From here on, I shall pursue an even 
greater brilliance with these legs of 
mine.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
As the new symbol of the "Splendid 
Clan"...!

—On that day, a new icon of the 
"Illustrious Clan" was born, one that 
would be spoken of for generations to 
come.

And that light will continue to shine 
without end. Through Daiichi Ruby... 
through her very own running.
